parse_events_jsonl: parse a JSONL string of CLI action entries into a list of dicts, skipping blank and malformed lines
action_to_event_dict: convert a CLI action dict into a structured event dict with operation type, metadata, and event ID
convert_events_jsonl: convert a JSONL string of CLI actions into a list of event objects with tool names and args
test_parse_events_jsonl: test the parse_events_jsonl function with single entries, multiple entries, empty input, and malformed lines
test_action_to_event_dict: test the action_to_event_dict function for write actions, read actions, missing fields, and all app names
